`oceancube` uses a five-dimensional contract for rectilinear ocean data. Start
with the [introduction](oceancube-introduction.html), then read the
[architecture](oceancube-architecture.html) and
[geometry and weights](oceancube-geometry-weights.html) articles.

```{r}
library(oceancube)
x <- ocean_cube(
  lon = c(-80, -79), lat = c(-12, -11), depth = 5,
  time = as.Date("2020-01-01") + 0:1,
  data = array(1:8, c(2, 2, 1, 2, 1)), vars = "temperature"
)
cube_extract(x, longitude = -79, latitude = -11, by = "value")
```
